hypotheses.name: CONSUMPTIVE_OBSERVATION_BLINDNESS
success_conditions: for each model prose preserve_correct is at most 8/12
for each model prose claim_correct is at least 10/12
for each model effect_typed preserve_correct is at least 10/12 and improves over prose by at least 3/12
for each model effect_typed claim_correct is at least 10/12
for each model invalid_json is at most 1/24 per condition
kill_conditions: either model has prose preserve_correct at least 10/12
either model has claim_correct below 10/12 in either condition
either model gains less than 3/12 preserve_correct from effect_typed
either model has effect_typed preserve_correct below 10/12
either model has invalid_json above 1/24 in either condition
hypotheses.scope: Local benign synthetic choice only; represented access tools are never executed
hypotheses.early_stop: qwen2.5:7b hit two preregistered kill conditions; qwen3:8b was not run
